events.title: Shane Nelson - Havannas (Superior WI)
events.description: Live music with songwriter Shane Nelson -grab some authentic Cubin food, a drink and a seat, and enjoy an evening of listening. Shane Nelson is a singer, songwriter, musician, and producer who has been following his artistic instincts to create since he was a child. Nelson started performing at school and community events when he was 8 years old. In his teens, Nelson built the band, “Crescent Moon”. Along with his band, Shane has earned recognition as one of the Northland’s top local musical acts by winning several battle of the bands competitions, being voted the Northland’s best live musical act by local radio stations, and through live performances throughout the Midwest. Nelson’s band has performed alongside nationally recognized acts such as Survivor, Toad the Wet Sprocket, and Confederate Railroad. As a solo artist, Shane has been featured on PBS television, has won several singer/songwriter contests, and earned the title of Northland Idol through a local ABC Television affiliate which landed him in Nashville, TN. Although Nelson has won several awards and has received recognition for his musical abilities, he is not in it for the eminence.

events.title: Mason Jennings
events.description: Mason Jennings is a Minnesota-based pop-folk singer-songwriter. Jennings is originally from Honolulu, Hawaii. He is well known for his simple yet catchy melodies, intimate lyrics, intensely literary and historical themes, and deep tenor's voice. His music has appeared in the surf film Shelter and he has toured extensively. Jennings is married to Amy Jennings (nee Turany) and has a son, August, born in January 2003. Jennings produced his self-titled debut album in 1997 on an analog four-track in the basement of a rented home, manning all instruments himself. In October 1998, after bringing drummer Chris Stock and bassist Robert Skoro on board, he began a weekly gig at Minneapolis' 400 Bar as the Mason Jennings Band. Garnering local praise and a wide fan base, Mason began touring nationally. His 2000 album Birds Flying Away revealed Jennings' political activism and penchant for singing first-person narratives of imaginary rustic characters. Following the release of this album, Noah Levy took over drumming duties from Stock. 2002 saw the release of two albums: the studio piece Century Spring and a "fans only" collection of acoustic rarities, Simple Life.

From "Haven't Met You Yet" to "Home" and "Sway" to "Feeling Good," every song is delivered with bold new arrangements, boundless energy and Shaun's Entertainer of the Year stylings. Billboard Top 5 artist and Emmy Award winner. "Shaun Johnson splits the difference between the dulcet urbanity of Michael Bublé and the campy yowl of the Stray Cats’ Brian Setzer. He fronts a brassy octet he dubs Shaun Johnson’s Big Band Experience (he’s also the lead singer of Tonic Sol-fa and Shaun Sings Country). A retro nerd of Rat Pack vintage, his performances go for the gut in rousing fashion.” ~ Minneapolis Star Tribune The Shaun Johnson Big Band Experience is a rare newcomer to traditional pop...fusing a big band spirit with an inventive edge...at once more risky than Buble, more modern than Sinatra.

events.title: The Steel Wheels: The West Theatre w/ Bobcat Oppossum
events.description: 20 years is a long time to spend doing anything at all. It’s an age for any group of people to sustain a collective effort. For a band on the road, 20 years can be more than a lifetime. Yet, after 2 decades of making music together in living rooms, listening rooms, clubs, theaters, and festival stages, The Steel Wheels are still growing, still pushing, still at it, and they’re marking the occasion with the release of their 9th studio album, “The Steel Wheels”. Following the release of “Sideways” in 2024, their 3rd record with producer Sam Kassirer at his Great North Sound Society studio in interior Maine, the band felt it was time for a change of scene. As the group began to select songs for a new album, they also had to find an answer to the question of where they would get down to the work of record-making. events.title: Teague Alexy
events.description: Award-winning Duluth-based musician, author and storyteller Teague Alexy is probably best known for his Americana songwriting in the national touring brothers duo Hobo Nephews of Uncle Frank. Teague’s songwriting is clearly influenced by his home in Minnesota, as well as his childhood in New Jersey, and life as a travelling musical hobo. Teague's storytelling has deeper roots to his Irish ancestry. The name ‘Teague’ was once used to describe the storytelling poets who travelled ancient Ireland. New album "Effervescent" available 2/14/16. Teague's second album of 2017 is a collaboration with Trampled By Turtles mandolin player Erik Berry. 'Irish American' features nine traditional Irish favorites, including "Whiskey in the Jar," "The Wild Colonial Boy" and "Mountain Dew," as well as two original songs. Teague’s first album of 2017, Circuit Sessions, combines multiple musical genres into a powerful new collection of Teague’s poetic songs with the lionstrong production and rhythm section of Eric Pollard (Actual Wolf) and Steve Garrington (Low) joined by Minneapolis guitarist Jake Hanson. Teague also has a new musical and storytelling podcast “Wisecracks & Roadside Flats.”

events.title: J Streitz and the Long Odds: J Streitz | The Ore House
events.description: J Streitz plays original folk/Americana songs along with a few covers by great songwriters including John Prine, Todd Snider, and Bob Dylan. While playing bass in several Minneapolis bands spanning over two decades, Jason Streitz quietly wrote country, bluegrass and folk songs in his spare time. These songs, along with a handful of new tunes would become the foundation for The Long Odds. In October of 2016 the band recorded their first full length record with engineer Nick Tveitbakk at the renowned Pachyderm Studios in Cannon Falls, MN. Level Ground was released in the winter of 2018 with special guests Jimmy Rogers and fiddle player Allie Kral (Yonder Mountain String Band) contributing their talents. In August of 2019 Jason moved with his family from Minneapolis to the north woods of Wisconsin where they now own and operate a small pottery business out of an old 1921 schoolhouse, Brickyard Pottery and Gallery. Operating now as Jason Streitz and the Long Odds the band is eager to complete their 2nd full length album. The bones of album #2 were recorded in June of 2019 at The Hideaway Studios in NE Minneapolis and is set to be released in the Winter of 2021.

events.title: The New Standards Holiday Show ~ Duluth, MN
events.description: The New Standards Holiday Show features the trio as wise-cracking hosts of a seasonal spectacle that's just Christmasy enough. With a little help from their friends, The New Standards warms the hearts of the grinchiest of grinches in what has become an enduring, and endearing, Minnesota holiday tradition. Minnesota stalwarts The New Standards create an intriguing blend of everything from classic cabaret to punk rock, from the freedom of jazz, to the soul of pop and rock. They make it work through sheer musicianship and offbeat humor. The instrumentation is simple: John Munson of Trip Shakespeare/Semisonic fame on bass; Chan Poling, founder of the new-wave group The Suburbs on piano; and Steve Roehm on vibes. Chan and John split the singing. A foot stomp here, a shout-out, a fiery solo, and it's cooked. Simple, elegant, illuminating.

events.title: Davina and The Vagabonds: A Vagabond Holiday
events.description: Davina and the Vagabonds bring a signature high-energy blend of blues, neo-soul, and swing to the winter season with their annual "A Vagabond Holiday" shows and festive recordings. Known for frontwoman Davina Sowers' distinctively soulful vocals and a heavy brass presence, the Twin Cities-based group frequently hits the road each winter. New Spin on an Old Sound Davina and the Vagabonds are playing your area soon! Davina Sowers and the Vagabonds have created a stir on the national music scene with their high-energy live shows, level A musicianship, sharp-dressed professionalism, and Sowers’ commanding stage presence. With influences ranging from Fats Domino and the Preservation Hall Jazz Band to Aretha Franklin and Tom Waits, the band is converting audiences one show at a time, from Vancouver to Miami and across Europe. In 2011 Davina released her first full length, all original album Black Cloud . It was named one of the 10 best releases of the year by the Minneapolis Star & Tribune and awarded 4 1⁄2 stars from Downbeat Magazine.

GB Leighton
events.description: The Event Center, Floodwood GB Leighton acoustic show The Event Center, Floodwood 201 West 7th Avenue Floodwood, MN 55736 More than 200 shows a year. Jubilant fans who follow him from Minnesota to Mexico. More than 100,000 albums sold. A new release “Get Up” and a state-of-the-art nightclub named after one of his songs -- all without the support of a major record label... Meet GB Leighton, a band named after one of the regions’ most incendiary live performers and consistently solid songwriters, Brian Leighton. Through more than a decade and eleven studio albums, Leighton and his five piece band have been tearing up rock clubs, festivals and even a few fan’s living rooms with a slew of songs that connect with the heart and couples singing along out on the dance floor. “A man of the people” is a phrase usually reserved for statesmen and politicians, but for Leighton, it’s a fitting description when you see him in action working a crowd. Leighton delivers that same inescapable rock ‘n’ roll spirit night after night. “If I hadn’t heard a bunch of Bruce’s bootlegs or seen the videos I’d be a much different musician,” he says today.

Expect big joy in close quarters --- the kind of evening where a room full of strangers ends up feeling like family by the last chorus. events.title: An Irish Christmas with Rend Collective - Duluth
events.description: Hailing from the rugged coast of Northern Ireland, Rend Collective has always believed that worship should feel more like a celebration than a performance. From their earliest days gathering on beaches and in living rooms to now leading worship across the world, the band has held tightly to one mission: to joyfully share the good news of Jesus through authentic, Spirit-filled worship. Since the release of their debut Organic Family Hymnal, Rend Collective has grown from a small worshipping community into a global voice, amassing over 1 billion career streams, and multiple gold and platinum selling singles, including fan favorites like “My Lighthouse,” “Counting Every Blessing,” and “Build Your Kingdom Here.” Their catalog also includes the international worship anthem “Hallelujah Anyway,” which has resonated deeply with churches around the world. The group’s breakout single “Build Your Kingdom Here” became an early global anthem, and their momentum carried into a historic run of chart-topping albums. The Art of Celebration debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard Christian Albums Chart, followed by several additional No. 1 records including As Family We Go, Good News, and Campfire.

Join an all-star lineup featuring Paul "Stretch" Diethelm and Ted Manderfeld, alongside powerhouse vocalists Pamela McNeill, Stacy Bauer, and Tim Haussner. They'll be backed by an incredible band including bassist Cody McKinney, saxophonist and flutist Mike Kreitzer, and drummer Pete Hennig. Experience timeless holiday hits like "Silent Night," "God Rest Ye Merry Gentlemen," "Jingle Bells," and "The Little Drummer Boy" reimagined with a rock twist that will get you into the holiday spirit like never before! Don't miss out on this unforgettable celebration of rock and holiday cheer!

events.description: Hairball is going Balls to the Wall in 2026 with a tour that cranks the arena rock experience into overdrive. For over 25 years, Hairball has blown away fans with spot-on recreations of rock’s greatest anthems, and this year is no exception. Expect lights, fire, smoke, and the ultimate Rock & Roll party that has to be seen to be believed. Don’t miss your chance to live the madness! The Bombastic Celebration of Arena Rock IT'S LIKE 20 CONCERTS IN ONE NIGHT! A band puts on a concert - Hairball puts on an event! Hairball is a Rock & Roll experience you won't soon forget. The lights, sound, smoke, fire, bombs, and screaming hoards of avid fans...to merely call it a concert would be like calling Mount Rushmore a roadside attraction! Vocalists Kris Vox, Dave Moody, and Patrick Stone lead the band through a 2+ hour, mind-blowing, and dropdead accurate homage to some of the biggest arena acts in the world. Van Halen, KISS, Motley Crue, Queen, Journey, and Aerosmith are but a few of the acts fans will see brought to life. events.description: Ian Alexy plays solo acoustic (with looping and effects, of course) on the third Saturday of every month at Sir Benedict's in Duluth. Troubadour 21st Century is the new record by singer-songwriter Ian Alexy. Best known for his work with Americana duo Hobo Nephews Of Uncle Frank, Ian expands the possibilities on Troubadour 21st Century with rock grooves and spine-tingling electric guitar flourishes. This is Ian Alexy’s fifth album as a solo artist, in addition to five albums with Hobo Nephews Of Uncle Frank. Hobo Nephews first earned their live reputation by opening a sold-out national tour for Trampled By Turtles before touring all over the United States as a headliner. Their 2015 song Old Number 4 was featured on CBS Sports.com and soon after went viral. Ian has received critical acclaim for his work as a solo artist as well. In addition to performing as a solo artist and with his band Ian Alexy and The Deserters, he is also working on a series of documentaries titled Making It Shine comprised of footage of life on the road and in the studio over the past several years. With the world re opening again the Troubadour 21st Century is ready to return to the music life.

We’ll bring the covers, originals, big guitars, and the kind of night that makes an ugly sweater feel like a power move. Come get weird, festive, and Indecent at Mr. D’s. Come out and get Indecent 😈😎🎸🤘💜 www.indyp218.com Indecent Proposal is a band out of Duluth, Minnesota, built around connection, feel, and songs that hold up in a room full of people. events.description: Andrew Crowley on the piano Andrew Crowley is a Twin Cities-based musician, composer, and audio engineer with a dynamic career spanning from major label rock stages to the baseball diamond. A certified Hammond Organ artist who studied through the Berklee School of Music, Andrew can often be found during the summer serving as the Musical Director and ballpark organist for the Saint Paul Saints, delivering live musical energy and stadium-sized sound at CHS Field. He can also be found leading a packed house in piano sing-alongs at Lyon's Pub, composing music for films, documentaries, and commercials, or working behind the console. He became internationally known in the 1990s as the frontman for Columbia Records' Fat Tuesday. Since then, a life of live performance has led to some pretty great happy accidents—like winding up on the outtakes of Pearl Jam’s 2003 Live at the Garden release, singing with Iggy Pop, playing with blues legends like Elvin Bishop, and many other things. Today, whether he is at the ballpark, the concert stage, or the pub, Andrew's career is built on a relentless passion for authentic, high-quality music.

events.description: The Last Revel is a four-piece folk group from Minneapolis, Minnesota. Utilizing their multi-instrumental abilities, members Lee Henke, Ryan Acker, and Vincenzio Donatelle, bring a full spectrum of modern Americana to life with lush arrangements of three-part vocal harmonies, acoustic guitar, upright bass, fiddle, and 5-string banjo to consistently support impassioned performances of their honest and heartfelt songwriting. The event also supports the Downtown Duluth Clean & Safe Team and the work they do throughout the downtown district.

events.title: Jay Webb
events.description: Country artist Jay Webb writes songs that hit like a gut punch. Raised between the backroads of North Alabama and the city in the south, music was how he made sense of the chaos around him. What started as a way to process a turbulent childhood quickly became his purpose — gritty storytelling over genre-blurring beats, delivered with zero filter. He started cutting demos in high school and never stopped, releasing track after track on his own and building a following from the ground up. His lyrics cut deep, his voice carries the scars and his sound refuses to stay in one lane. Webb doesn’t clean up the mess — he leans into it, and has a good time doing it. Pulling from a wide range of influences, he pairs the weight of Johnny Cash and Hank Williams with the edge of Juice WRLD and Post Malone. It’s not traditional country — and he doesn’t want it to be. He calls it “music for real people with real problems,” and his fans know exactly what that means. In 2022, a viral TikTok pushed his music to a wider audience. Since then, he’s dropped standout tracks like “Down Here,” “Bury Me With Bourbon” and “Broken,” racking up over 415M streams and more than 2M fans.

events.title: Mitchell Tenpenny
events.description: Six years into his record deal with Columbia Records, Mitchell Tenpenny is leaning in even more. On his new album “The 3rd,” the Nashville native is leaning into his story, his fans, his roots and his influences – all with an eye on the future. Country radio knows Tenpenny as a reliable hitmaker and husky-voiced storyteller with an ear for undeniable hooks and unforgettable melodies. Fans who care to listen deeper recognize that he not only produces country radio smashes but is also a genre disruptor unafraid of punctuating his country storytelling with edgy lyrics, hard-driving drum beats and heavy guitars. “The 3rd” is Tenpenny’s most authentic – and adventurous – album yet. Named after a song that was named after him, “The 3rd” is a testament to his personal growth and artistic evolution. No longer playing games, Tenpenny has crafted an album that resonates with his own experiences and emotions. This honest and empathetic collection showcases his maturity as a man, singer, songwriter, and storyteller and invites listeners to join him on his creative journey through life and music. “I want this record to be all over the place,” Tenpenny said.

events.title: Flo Rida
events.description: Tramar Dillard [born December 16th 1979], better known by the stage name of Flo Rida, is an American rapper. He was born in Opa-locka, Florida but raised in Carol City, and chose his name from his home state. As a teenager, he toured with local rap group 2 Live Crew. Later, he appeared in numerous popular rap mixtapes, most notably in 'We The Best' by DJ Khaled in 2006, when he was signed to the Poe Boy Entertainment label, distributed by Atlantic Records. 'Mail On Sunday' is the debut album by the American hip hop artist Flo Rida. Flo Rida explained the versatility of the album with the following, "I cover everything from hardships to struggle to the good times at the club. I got a song called 'Freaky,' I got party music, I got something for the car. I got all different types of music". Flo Rida also elaborated on the title of the album stating, "Well, this record is like my special delivery for the fans. Itâ€TMs not something you can get during the 6 regular mail delivery days. You need that extra day for your prized possessions. Thatâ€TMs Mail on Sunday." The album debuted at No.3 on the U.S. Billboard 200 chart, selling 85,891 copies in its first week.

events.description: This is an unplugged show. Daughtry, one of the most visible and best-selling rock bands of the 21st century, has sold out concerts across the globe. Their debut album, the self-titled Daughtry, was the top-selling album of 2007 and was the fastest selling rock debut album in Soundscan history. The record was nominated for 4 GRAMMY® Awards and won 4 American Music Awards, alongside 7 Billboard Music Awards, including “Album of the Year.” Subsequent albums, Leave This Town (2009), Break The Spell (2011), and Baptized (2013) have all gone Platinum, with Cage To Rattle (2018) certified Gold. In 2021, the band released their record Dearly Beloved, with singles “World On Fire,” “Heavy Is The Crown,” and “Changes Are Coming,” all cracking the Top 10. Following yet another Top 10 success with their 2023 smash cover of Journey’s “Separate Ways (Worlds Apart)" featuring Halestorm's Lzzy Hale, Daughtry ushered in a new sonic era with their debut Big Machine Rock single, “Artificial.” The return to their heavy roots scored the band their first No. 1 single in the Active Rock format, followed by yet another No. 1 with follow up track, “Pieces.”

events.title: KC and The Sunshine Band
events.description: KC and The Sunshine Band formed in 1973 with one single purpose: to create instant happiness through music - and the group has done just that, topping the charts with singles including “Give It Up”, “That’s the Way (I Like It),” “Please Don’t Go,” “Get Down Tonight,” “Boogie Shoes”, “I’m Your Boogie Man” and “(Shake, Shake, Shake) Shake Your Booty,” tallying worldwide sales of over 100 million. events.title: Guys On Ice
events.description: Grab your thermos, drill a hole in the ice, and settle in for the hilarious musical comedy about friendship, fishing, and frozen winters. The Quintessential Comedy of the North From the land of ten thousand lakes to the frozen bays of the Great Lakes, Guys on Ice is hitting the road to celebrate the secret language of the North: ice fishing. This beloved musical comedy invites audiences into a world where the beer is cold, the stove is warm, and the wisdom is as thick as the ice on the lake. More than just a play, Guys on Ice is a musical tribute to the stubborn resilience of Midwesterners. Featuring show-stopping numbers like "De Wishing Hole," "Fish is de Miracle Food," and the legendary "Ode to a Snowmobile Suit" (featuring a zipper dance routine you have to see to believe), this production captures the heart, the humor, and the "oh-fer-cute" charm of life on the ice.

events.title: NEEDTOBREATHE
events.description: Despite a 20-year history that includes all the accolades of an iconic band, GRAMMY-nominated, multi-platinum band NEEDTOBREATHE came into their latest studio album with a much different frame of mind. They still felt they had something to prove. In truth, this is a band who have loomed large for years, leveraging a unique fusion of modern rock, purpose-driven soul and irresistible pop appeal into a stat line which puts them in exceedingly rare company. They’ve placed five Number One albums all across the Billboard chart spectrum, from Rock and Alternative. They’ve racked up two billion career streams and scored multi-platinum chart topping hits – “Brother” (feat. Gavin DeGraw), “Who Am I,” “Let’s Stay Home Tonight” and dozens more. And they’ve done it all while filling venues across the globe. Ask their fans and it’s been two decades of spirit-mining songs, master musicianship and elemental artistry, digging deep to create a series of sonic monuments to the human condition. Their most recent effort follows suit.

events.title: NEEDTOBREATHE
events.description: NEEDTOBREATHE has established itself as one of the most dynamic and influential bands in modern rock. Known for their powerful live shows and emotionally resonant songwriting, the band has released a string of critically acclaimed albums, earned multiple GRAMMY nominations, and built a devoted audience around the world. Their music blends rock, Americana, soul, and gospel influences into a sound that is uniquely their own, anchored by songs that speak to perseverance, faith, redemption, and the shared human experience. On November 19, the band is set to release The Long Surrender and The Fellow Passengers of Pain, the deluxe edition of their acclaimed album The Long Surrender.

events.description: With a legendary career spanning five decades, KANSAS has firmly established itself as one of America’s iconic classic rock bands. This "garage band" from Topeka released their debut album in 1974 after being discovered by Wally Gold, who worked for Don Kirshner, and have gone on to sell more than 30 million albums worldwide. Composing a catalogue that includes sixteen studio albums and five live albums, KANSAS has produced eight gold albums, three sextuple-Platinum albums (Leftoverture, Point of Know Return, Best of KANSAS), one platinum live album (Two for the Show), one quadruple-Platinum single ‘Carry On Wayward Son,’ and another triple-Platinum single ‘Dust in the Wind.’ KANSAS appeared on the Billboard charts for over 200 weeks throughout the ‘70's and ‘80's and played to sold-out arenas and stadiums throughout North America, Europe and Japan. ‘Carry On Wayward Son’ continues to be one of the top five most played songs on classic rock radio, and ‘Dust In the Wind’ has been played on the radio more than three million times!

events.title: Ski North Ultra
events.description: Ski North Ultra is an ultra-distance 100K cross-country skiing classic-only event along the North Shore of Lake Superior. The event has 38K and 100K options, following the Norpine, Cascade River State Park and Bally Creek trail systems near Lutsen, MN. This is a unique cross-country ski event. It is classic-skiing only, and will be on a mix of double-track and single-track ski trails. The trails are incredibly beautiful, and also very technical. State park skiing can mean narrow, sharp turns, and the terrain along Lake Superior can mean long, 20-30 minute climbs, and sharp, steep descents. The 100K race uses advanced courses. The 38K stays on intermediate trails, but please consider if this is the right fit for your skill level. This is a tough course. March snow conditions can be varying, and can also be the most wonderful time of year to enjoy skiing. The event is more of an adventure than a race. Come with an open mind and adventurous spirit, and you will have a great day. Start and finish in Cascade River State Park. Glide through birch, fir, cedar and pine forests, with overlooks of Lake Superior.

Experience three exciting race categories: * Pepsi Challenge 50K Freestyle & Classic * Great River Energy Rush 25K Freestyle & Classic * Giants Ridge 8K Cross Country Ski Race Our family-friendly events welcome skiers of all skill levels. With our no hassle guarantee, you can park, register, stay, race, dine, and relax all in one convenient location. After the race, unwind with a shower, swim and sauna just a short walk away. Giants Ridge offers 60 kilometers of impeccably groomed, world-class Nordic trails, hosting events like the World Cup, Olympic Trials, National Collegiate Finals, U.S. National Championships, and High School Championships. The Pepsi Challenge Cup Race is part of the American Ski Marathon Series and a Birkie Qualifier. Join us on Minnesota's Iron Range for an exciting late-winter cross-country ski experience! We are also seeking volunteers and welcome input from anyone interested in enhancing the quality of our event. Please email pepsichallenge@giantsridge.com with your availability to volunteer or share your feedback.

events.title: Mo Pitney @ The Reif PAC
events.description: When Mo Pitney sings "let me tell you about country" in his debut single, he's doing more than telling. He's showing. Appropriately titled, the song "Country" is as much positioning statement as introduction. In three minutes and 16 seconds, it is almost precisely who he is in word and deed. The vocal delivery, storytelling, musicianship and reflections of his outdoor lifestyle – as well as faith, family and patriotism – offer a spot-on portrayal. Joined by early fan favorites "Clean Up On Aisle Five" and "Come Do A Little Life," the song carves an unmistakably country yet completely fresh groove for the genre. In short, it sounds like nothing else, but absolutely belongs. To paraphrase the song, a life in music isn't a place on a map; it's a place in Mo Pitney's heart. "I just love music," Pitney says, exhibiting atypical maturity for someone still in their early twenties. "It has never been about praise. Playing the Grand Ole Opry was an amazing experience, but I have just as much fun sitting on my bed playing along to an old record. It's always been that way." That music-centered outlook is already generating the unsought acclaim of which he speaks.

Martin Sexton
events.description: America comes together in the music of Martin Sexton. Our hearts mend, our political and philosophical differences melt away, and the various strains of our roots music entangle. Of Sexton, The New York Times says: “His unpretentious heartiness helps him focus on every soul singer’s goal: to amplify the sound of the ordinary heart." Sexton has remained true to his mission of sharing peace and harmony throughout his 10 albums, and in countless incendiary live performances. He has thus built a loyal following of fans, including critics and superstar artists. He is without a doubt what Billboard calls: “The real thing.” These days, people are coming together to revel in Sexton’s musicality for his Martin Sexton Abbey Road Show. This is a live show extravaganza in which he performs the iconic Beatles’ album in its entirety followed by a set of mainly original music. Sexton is a songwriter’s songwriter, with a multi-octave voice that knows no bounds. Acoustic Guitar Magazine calls him a: "Master of dynamics, reducing a room to silence with his blustering baritone, then teasing that silence with a fluttering falsetto."

events.title: Kray Van Kirk
events.description: A fine finger-style guitarist with a precise baritone, Kray Van Kirk has a Ph.D. from the University of Alaska, but he set science aside to write songs and tell stories. “There is a reason for hero stories," he says, hidden in plain sight and cloaked in the everyday. The dragons look different, the monsters wear suits, the quest hides behind the mundane and appears utterly futile, but the work is the same. Defeat Empire! Build Utopia!" When he reached Scotland and the Fringe Festival, the Daily Fringe Review wrote “The evening's act was Kray Van Kirk, whose 12-string guitar and soaring vocals were spellbinding; the singer-songwriter, in his Edinburgh debut, was not the reason I arrived early, but was certainly why I stayed late." Of this charming, Quixotic and eclectic performer, the Borderline Folk Club in New York wrote that Van Kirk was "what every singer-songwriter should aspire to."

events.title: Them Coulee Boys
events.description: “A rollicking blend of bluegrass, folk, and rock and roll” - Folk Alley Soren Staff and Beau Janke—co-founders of folk/rock/Americana outfit Them Coulee Boys—met as camp counselors in northern Wisconsin in 2011. Their weekend workshopping of Avett Brothers and classic country tunes led to original songs and adding Soren’s brother Jens on mandolin, Neil Krause on electric bass and Stas Hable on drums. The band’s name is a nod to the glacial melt-carved river valleys they call home, known by early French fur trappers as coulees. Known for wild swings of emotion during sets, it is not unusual to see fans in tears and minutes later dancing with abandon. The honesty and ability to talk and sing about the feelings and emotions that shape them has endeared them to a growing group of fans and friends. Over the course of five albums, the band has garnered international attention and earned press in Americana UK, American Songwriter, Ditty TV, Folk Alley, and The Bluegrass Situation.

events.title: Tennessee Whiskey Revival
events.description: Honoring the integrity of the original Chris Stapleton compositions while infusing each performance with soulful energy and expressive musicianship, the band offers a sound that is both authentic and fresh. Since their 2025 debut, Tennessee Whiskey Revival (featuring Scott Kirby) has quickly established itself as a premier Chris Stapleton tribute, captivating audiences across the Northwoods and beyond. To the stage they bring their roots - rock, bluegrass, soul, folk, country, and other influences - merging their colorful musicianship in tribute to musician and songwriter Chris Stapleton. In seizing this opportunity, their sound is designed like no other band paying tribute to the legendary performer Chris Stapleton. While their construct maintains the integrity of Chris Stapleton originals, their soulful energy and heartfelt solos color each masterfully composed song. The vibe of the musicians is fresh and forward. "Scott Kirby’s Tennessee Whiskey Revival—a heartfelt tribute to Chris Stapleton—delivers powerhouse vocals, exceptional musicianship, and pure soul. A must-see performance!" (Sandra Madden, Executive Director, Campanile Center for the Arts)

events.title: Red Corvette - A Prince Tribute Band
events.description: Red Corvette — A Prince Tribute Band brings the sound, style, and energy of Prince to the stage. With a tight live band, powerhouse vocals, unforgettable hits, and the classic moves fans love, Red Corvette delivers a high-energy celebration of Prince’s extraordinary legacy. Get ready to dance, sing along, and take a ride with Red Corvette. Red Corvette — A Prince Tribute Band — delivers the music, energy, and electric spirit of Prince in a high-impact live tribute experience. For years, Red Corvette has brought Prince’s unmistakable blend of funk, rock, pop, and showmanship to stages with a tight live band, powerhouse vocals, and the classic moves and moments audiences love. From “Dearly Beloved” through the final encore, the show celebrates the songs, style, and fearless energy that made Prince an icon. Red Corvette is dedicated to honoring Prince’s extraordinary legacy with an authentic, high-energy performance built to hit hard every time it takes the stage. Take a ride with Red Corvette.

events.title: SISU Ski Fest 2027
events.description: Welcome to the 18th annual SISU Ski Fest, a premier cross country ski race, held in Ironwood, MI January 9, 2027. 2027 Highlights: 30K SISU & 15K Heikki Lunta ski races. Five year age groups, more prizes, and cloth bibs! Capacity is 940 registered. Summer race course improvements include adding curves to a few sharp corners and widening the Highlands Aid Station area. Larger indoor warming area near Start Line. There is now a 15K "Low Snow Loop" located completely at ABR that can be used in case there is not enough snow to facilitate finishing in downtown Ironwood. "Finnish" Line in Ironwood's Downtown City Square. 5K Hauska Hiihto Fun Ski, and Depot Dash for kids on Friday. While the COVID-19 pandemic seems behind us, we do still ask anyone with symptoms of illness to remain home. Sisu is a Finnish cultural concept encompassing strength and determination in the face of adversity. It involves a combination of stamina, perseverance, courage, and determination held in reserve for hard times.

Dress in your Howloween best and get down in galaxy of good vibes on the cosmic stage. 🎶 Hot Tamale Cosmos | 8–9 PM 🎸 Saltydog | 9–11 PM 🎟️ $20 at the door (Ticketed Event) Every dollar of door proceeds goes directly to the bands. Come dressed to impress, bring your dancing shoes, and help us show some love to the local musicians who make nights like this special. Costumes encouraged. Good vibes guaranteed. Let’s get weird!

events.title: Live Music: Hot Tamale Cosmos
events.description: Hot Tamale Cosmos is a group of artists from the Northland who have all had their own projects and successes and have come together over common love of song and harmonies. These women have performed in such groups as, and not limited to: Superior Siren, Danny Frank and the Smoky Gold, Boss Mama and the Jebberhooch, Ross Thorn Band, Junkyard Mule, Feeding Leroy and the Morris Park Singers. The women-led supergroup will be sharing original tunes as well as covers by artists such as Iris Dement, Bob Dylan and Gillian Welch. The Cosmos are Erin Aldridge, Colleen "Boss Mama" Myhre, Jocelyn Mickelsen, Jen Krussow and Sonja Martin.

events.title: Live Music: Saltydog
events.description: Their rhythms may be a little bossy. Their drummers commanded me to feel Saucy. Another Duluth band that can hold a groove. The Bass lines funk and the bootys move. Some songs tell stories and others tell moods. They sing about friends and they sing about foods. With Improvisations both jarring and dreamy, one guitar clucks and the other ones creamy. Looking for a band to follow outta the fog? Well look no further than Saltydog. Duluth-based northwoods funk jam band Saltydog consists of Jacob Mahon on guitar and vocals, drummer Owen “Owie”Mahon (who also does vocals), Sam Deters on guitar, Bryon “Lefty” Johnson on percussion, Calvin “Calzone” Lund on the Bass and Gavin St. Clair on the keys.

events.title: Sunhee's Little Table - Authentic Korean Food Truck
events.description: Sunhee’s Little Table at Bent Paddle 🍜 Sunhee’s Little Table is bringing authentic Korean flavors to Bent Paddle for a pop-up you won’t want to miss. Come grab a pint (or THC bev) and dig into some seriously good, made-from-scratch Korean comfort food. Here’s a taste of what they’ll be serving up: Bulgogi (불고기) Thinly sliced beef marinated in a savory mix of soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, and a touch of sweetness—then grilled to perfection. Rich, flavorful, and made for pairing with a cold beer. Tteokbokki (떡볶이) A Korean street food favorite featuring chewy rice cakes in a spicy-sweet chili sauce. Bold, comforting, and just the right amount of heat. Bulgogi Kimbap (불고기 김밥) Korean-style rolls packed with marinated bulgogi, fresh veggies, and rice, all wrapped in seaweed. Easy to snack on and perfect alongside your favorite Bent Paddle pour. Come hungry, grab a drink, and enjoy something a little different in the Taproom.

events.title: MN Pint Day!!
events.description: 🍺 MN Beer Day at Bent Paddle! MN Beer Day is all about celebrating Minnesota craft beer and supporting the breweries, brewpubs, and communities that make our industry special. Breweries across the state come together to raise funds for the Minnesota Craft Brewers Guild, a vital organization advocating for and supporting Minnesota’s craft brewing industry. It’s also the perfect excuse to visit your favorite local taproom, discover new brews, and show some love to Minnesota-made beer! 🍻 What’s the Deal? Purchase a limited-edition MN Beer Day pint glass for $8 and receive one complimentary fill! Glasses are limited and available while supplies last, so stop in, grab a glass, enjoy a pint, and help support Minnesota craft beer.

events.title: Live Music: Roadside Lupines
events.description: The Roadside Lupines are a 4-piece folk band based out of Duluth, Minnesota. After meeting in college, the band came together in 2023, blending heartfelt original songs with soulful covers spanning from Duluth’s own Trampled by Turtles to Shania Twain. With a name and music rooted in the North Shore, they capture the spirit of life up north and the place they are grateful to call home. The Roadside Lupines released their debut album at the tail end of 2025! Check it out wherever you get your music.

events.description: Bent Paddle Blitz Wednesdays ♟️ Wednesdays | 7:00–9:00 PM Join us every Wednesday for Bent Paddle Blitz, a casual evening of fast-paced chess, great beer, and friendly competition at Bent Paddle Brewing Co. Whether you're a seasoned player or just learning the game, all skill levels are welcome. Drop in for a few matches or stay all evening—no registration required. events.title: Birds & Brews - All About Cranes!
events.description: Cranes have captivated people around the world for centuries with their calls, dances, and incredible journeys. Join the International Crane Foundation at Bent Paddle for an evening celebrating these extraordinary birds and learning about the work being done to protect cranes and the wild places where they dance. Event Info: Thursday, NOV. 5th 6-9pm Bent Paddle Taproom Hope is at the heart of conservation. Every wetland restored, every crane chick hatched, and every person who falls in love with these birds helps build a better future. Hear stories from the field, discover what makes cranes so unique, and learn how conservation efforts around the world are helping protect their future. Event is free! Pre-registration is encouraged but not required. Part of the International Crane Foundation’s Minnesota tour, November 5–10, 2026. Questions? Contact Hannah Field at hfield@savingcranes.org or 608-356-9462 ext. 117.

events.title: Live Music: Wetland Willows
events.description: Brooke and Caleb Anderson are the wife and husband duo who make up Wetland Willows. The pair creates a full sound, with Brooke on vocals, guitar, stomp box, and foot tambourine, while Caleb adds depth with piano basslines, melodies, and syncopated rhythms. Brooke’s songwriting features rich melodies, gospel undertones, and thoughtful lyrics, influenced by the sounds of New Orleans and Gypsy-folk. Before they decided to start a musical project between just the two of them, they performed with other bands. They’ve played together in the Holy Hootenanners, they sit in with Boss Mama & the Jebberhooch, and Brooke is half of the MinorBirds duo that’s also often supported by a full band including Caleb. Wetland Willows’ fun Americana sound contains a seasoned and soulful depth.

events.title: Board Game Night w/t DBGA "Duluth Board Game Alliance"
events.description: Thursday Board Game Night 🎲 Casual board gamers, seasoned strategists, and curious newcomers are all welcome! Bring a favorite game to share, or just show up and learn something new. We play a wide mix—from classics like Catan, Risk, and Taboo to strategy favorites like Wyrmspan, Five Tribes, and Castles of Burgundy, plus plenty of lighter games like Codenames, Kingdomino, New York Zoo, and Point Salad. Expect a relaxed, social night with games for all experience levels. We typically have 10–15 players, splitting into groups of 3–8 and mixing things up as games finish. Can’t make it right at 6? No problem! Games usually run until around 8:30–9 PM, and new games start throughout the evening, so feel free to jump in whenever you arrive. All ages welcome. The group is primarily adults, but high schoolers occasionally join us. Participants under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. 🎲 No game? No experience? No problem. Just come play!

events.title: Live Music: Sister Veery w/ Eldri Snow
events.description: Sister Veery is a Duluth-based electric folk rock band whose spacious sound blends electric piano and lilting vocal harmonies with an atmospheric band that will transport you to outer space and deep into your heart. Fronted by classically trained singer and pianist Molly Hilgenberg, Sister Veery brings together the talents of Shanna Willie on drums, Michael Geraci on bass, Chris Rourke on guitar, and Adeline Wright on vocals. In 2025, Sister Veery released their debut full-length album, Cosmic Relevance, supported by an individual artist grant from the Arrowhead Regional Arts Council. Written over the course of a decade, the album draws inspiration from Hilgenberg’s years living among the redwoods and along the coast of Northern California, pairing expansive soundscapes with reflections on life’s bigger questions. Opening for Sister Veery is beloved Duluth singer-songwriter Eldri Snow. Eldri is a radio host and champion of women in music through her programming on The North 103.3 FM.

events.description: Father Hennepin is an American alternative country band from Duluth, Minnesota. Since releasing the debut album "Crooked With Gin" in 2001, the band has been perennial headliners of the Homegrown Music Festival in Duluth.[1] Frontman Starfire is the founder of the Homegrown Music Festival,[2] pirate radio station Random Radio, and Perfect Duluth Day.[3] Father Hennepin is best known for their revival of the Moose Wallow Ramblers song written by John Berquist "I Like It in Duluth".

events.description: Attention all burger fanatics!! You can't buy happiness, but you can buy a burger, and that's kind of the same thing. With a menu that consists of mouthwatering Burgers to satisfy your craving, Burger Joint not only has the tastiest combinations on the menu, but all ingredients are fresh and locally sourced. All patties are a premium blend of chuck, brisket and short rib. Order online to reduce wait time!

events.title: Live Music: Berserk Blondes!
events.description: The Berserk Blondes! are Duluth's premier comic dance band. We'll make you laugh, make you groove, and maybe even play something resembling music. Iron Range Safety Hazard Steve Solkela and Duluth's Famous Kaylee Matuszak join funky forces, possibly with an extra pal or two. Join us on our adventure towards musical excellence.

events.title: HighKey Mondays + Industry Night!
events.description: 🎶 HighKey Mondays + Industry Night! 🍻 Live local music | Drink specials | Weekly 6–9 PM High Key Monday is FRIYAY for many of our industry partners—and we’re roll with it. Calling all restaurant, bar, liquor store, and brewery professionals in the Twin Ports—and anywhere our beer or alternative beverages are sold. Industry Pros Deal: Show a worker ID or pay stub for $1 off all bent paddle beverages. Thank you for keeping our paddles in the water! Everyone’s welcome: Come for the tunes, stay for the conversations and if you’re not slagging beverages - no worries, we got you. This month, connect with local organizations making waves in the Twin Ports—like WE Health, Trans+ Northland, Twin Ports Artists Collective, and Men As Peacemakers. Org’s may vary based on who available each week, but the good vibes are guaranteed! Deets: ~ 6-9p ~ $4 Light Lagers (For everyone!)

events.title: Tortoise & Hare Footwear Weekly Fun Run
events.description: Lace up and join Tortoise & Hare Footwear every Monday for a weekly community run along the Cross City Trail, starting and finishing right here at Bent Paddle Brewing Co.! Whether you're a first-time jogger or a seasoned runner, all paces are welcome in this fun, supportive, and judgment-free space. Details: 🗓 Every Monday, year-round (rain, snow, or shine—within reason!) ⏰ Runs begin at 6 PM 📍 Meet at Bent Paddle 📏 Choose your own pace and distance, anywhere from 2–5 miles Come for the run, stay for the community.

events.title: Taco Tuesday - Hungry Hippie Taco Pop-Up!
events.description: Join Hungry Hippie Tacos as they serve up their tasty tacos from 5pm-7pm, in the Taproom during Tuesday Trivia Nights at Bent Paddle Tacos + Trivia + Beer + THC Beverages = ❤️ Event Category: Pop Up Food…

events.title: Taps & Trivia Night - With Trivia Mafia
events.description: Taps + Trivia 🧠🍺🍃❓ 👯🧑‍🤝‍🧑👫 Bring your brightest crew, flex those brain muscles, and compete for *gobs of sweet prizes and spoils. So your a smarty pants, prove it! 🤲 Free to Play Trivia is free to join. We simply ask that you order beverages throughout the night and take good care of your friendly beertenders 🙏 Prize Breakdown* 1st Place: • Drink Token & Sticker – One per Team Member • Branded Beer Coozy - One per team member • $15 GC 2nd Place: • Drink Token & Sticker – One per Team Member 3rd Place: • BOGO Card & Sticker - One per team member Growler Drawing Every full-price beverage earns one entry into the end-of-night growler drawing—plus bragging rights until next week.

events.title: Live Music: TNT HiFi Paddle Splash Reggae Party
events.description: BP Tropical Getaway! Come see what the big SPLASH is all about. Featuring a night dedicated to the, musicality and resilience of Reggae Music & Culture. Positive vibes curated by Al Pajamas & Natty Nico on the TNT HiFi Sound System. Now in Cinemascope! Wednesday Nights House DJ Jam Session.

events.title: Board Game Night w/t DBGA "Duluth Board Game Alliance"
events.description: Thursday Board Game Night 🎲 Casual board gamers, seasoned strategists, and curious newcomers are all welcome! Bring a favorite game to share, or just show up and learn something new. We play a wide mix—from classics like Catan, Risk, and Taboo to strategy favorites like Wyrmspan, Five Tribes, and Castles of Burgundy, plus plenty of lighter games like Codenames, Kingdomino, New York Zoo, and Point Salad. Expect a relaxed, social night with games for all experience levels. We typically have 10–15 players, splitting into groups of 3–8 and mixing things up as games finish. Can’t make it right at 6? No problem! Games usually run until around 8:30–9 PM, and new games start throughout the evening, so feel free to jump in whenever you arrive. All ages welcome. The group is primarily adults, but high schoolers occasionally join us. Participants under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. 🎲 No game? No experience? No problem. Just come play!

events.title: Double Shot Double Black Friday - Taproom Vintage Release
events.description: Double Shot Double Black Friday – Vintage Bottle Release! It’s that time of year again! We’ve dug deep into our cellar to bring you some of our most decadent Double Shot Double Black (DSDB) vintages. What’s Available: • Pick 3 Flights: Choose any combination of DSDB vintages on draft while supplies last. • 750ml Bottles: Rare vintages from 2016–2023.

events.title: Johnny B's - Food Truck
events.description: Join us at Johnny B's Food Truck for an extraordinary culinary experience! Must try, New American Cuisine featuring local, seasonal, and organic ingredients. Try our famous smash burgers, smoked salmon salads, mushroom tartlets, and more! 🍔 Mouthwatering Smash Burgers: Sink your teeth into the juiciest, most succulent smash burgers around. 🥗 Fresh and Zesty Smoked Salmon Salad. 🍄 Calling all mushroom enthusiasts to delight in our delectable mushroom tartlets.

events.title: Sunhee's Little Table - Authentic Korean Food Truck
events.description: Sunhee’s Little Table at Bent Paddle 🍜 Sunhee’s Little Table is bringing authentic Korean flavors to Bent Paddle for a pop-up you won’t want to miss. Come grab a pint (or THC bev) and dig into some seriously good, made-from-scratch Korean comfort food. Here’s a taste of what they’ll be serving up: Bulgogi (불고기) Thinly sliced beef marinated in a savory mix of soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, and a touch of sweetness—then grilled to perfection. Rich, flavorful, and made for pairing with a cold beer. Tteokbokki (떡볶이) A Korean street food favorite featuring chewy rice cakes in a spicy-sweet chili sauce. Bold, comforting, and just the right amount of heat. Bulgogi Kimbap (불고기 김밥) Korean-style rolls packed with marinated bulgogi, fresh veggies, and rice, all wrapped in seaweed. Easy to snack on and perfect alongside your favorite Bent Paddle pour. Come hungry, grab a drink, and enjoy something a little different in the Taproom.

events.title: Small Business Saturday - Art on Tap Makers Market
events.description: 🎨 Art on Tap: Small Business Saturday 2026 Shop local and celebrate the makers, crafters, and artists who make our community special! Join us at Bent Paddle for Art on Tap, a day dedicated to supporting small businesses and keeping our hard-earned dollars right here in Lincoln Park and the greater Duluth community. Grab a pint, find something unique, and show some love to the local folks who make our Northland community what it is. ❤️ 🍜 Food Partner: Sunhee’s | 12–8 PM 🛍️ Meet our 2026 Small Biz Vendors: ~ Marvelous Melissa ~ Sally Cavallaro Designs ~ Boho Designs ~ Jennifer Walters – Author North Country Craft ~ Gitchie Glass ~ Simply Lush Soap Co. ~ Grey Lady ~ Jack Stevenson Knits Come out, shop small, support local, and make a day of it at Bent Paddle. Every purchase makes a difference!

events.title: Live Music: The Yeah Scherz w/ special guests Jennifer Fagre-Golya (DSSO and Mesabi Orchestra) and Ethan Skelton (Flywheel)
events.description: The Yeah Scherz have it all. Intricate vocals, intertwining instrumentation, unique covers, and most importantly, beards. An amalgam of many of the great Northlands bands, they’ve been playing together for two decades and it shows. TYS does not disappoint. For this show The Yeah Scherz are joined by special guests Jennifer Fagre-Golya (DSSO and Mesabi Symphony Orchestra) and Ethan Skelton (Flywheel)
